notes:
A350:
• Fixed: The cabin LED strips no longer flicker (in our test view 0 flickers in 147 frames, 34 in 137 before).
• Fixed: The A350-900 ULR cabin lights stayed dark when the flight was loaded straight into the cabin.
• Improved: Light scenes change smoothly: the strips brighten together with the cabin lights, in fine steps instead of 8, and a scene picked on the panel takes 6 s.
• Improved: Lighter cabin strips: 22 parts per cabin instead of 162, and about 1,200 fewer per-frame rules in the A350-900 cabin.
• Improved: Seat screens use far less video memory: pages you left free their pictures after 45 s (1.9 MB instead of 24.5 MB for two screens).
• Improved: Films and YouTube on screens the sim is not drawing take 1 frame a second instead of 25.
777:
• Fixed: The cabin curtains no longer stay out. They close only in the cruise, and stay as you set them.
• Improved: Seat screens use far less video memory: pages you left free their pictures after 45 s.
• Improved: Films and YouTube on screens the sim is not drawing take 1 frame a second instead of 25.
